name: Hevy-Progress
description: Hevy My Progress is a colorful, self-hosted analytics dashboard for Hevy workout data. Track consistency, strength progression, training volume, muscle balance, recovery, personal records, monthly reports and your full workout calendar. Sync workouts and available body measurements through the Hevy API, or import workout CSV exports. The Measurements tab also supports manual entries and history charts. Includes workout history filters, quick date presets, pinned overview metrics, and clear sync status. Built primarily for my own training workflow and shared for others who may find it useful; your data, training style and preferences may differ, so some mappings, goals, analytics, defaults or settings may need adjustment. Unofficial project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Hevy.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent SQLite database and application data.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: HTTP port for the Hevy My Progress dashboard.

variables.name: Hevy API Key
variables.description: Optional Hevy API key for automatic workout and available body-measurement synchronization. Leave blank for workout CSV import and manual body measurements.

variables.name: Dashboard Username
variables.description: Optional dashboard username. Set both username and password to enable HTTP Basic Authentication.

variables.name: Dashboard Password
variables.description: Optional dashboard password. Use HTTPS if accessing the dashboard outside your trusted LAN.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used for workout dates, calendar days and week boundaries.

variables.name: Sync Interval
variables.description: Seconds between automatic Hevy API syncs. Minimum effective value is 300 seconds.
